9/29/26, 9:42 AM
change in period demand only influences the forecast period that follows directly after.

The expected meter reading is determined as follows:

1. Determination of meter reading difference 01-2 to 01-1: 1,200 kWh 1,000 kWh = 200 kWh
=> Consumption for 01-2 = 200 kWh

2. Determination of consumption per weighting unit: 200 kWh : 300 = 2/3 kWh

3. Extrapolation of consumption for period 01-4 to 01-5: 2/3 kWh300 = 200 kWh
=> Meter reading difference for period 01-4 to 01-5= 200 kWh

4. Determination of the expected meter reading to 01-5 by adding the meter reading difference to meter reading 01-4:
2,000 kWh + 200 kWh = 2,200 kWh

The expected meter reading at time 01-5 is 2,200 kWh.
